authorization: User explicitly approved local reconciliation and requested that extra NetSuite lines not block the IR number, including partial receiving.
specApproval: Detailed executable spec not separately approved (autonomous run).
scopeAddition: The completed POB04042 incident recovery is extended with a deployed application fix for source-verified additional purchase charge lines.
setup: Use existing Node, TypeScript, ESLint, fast-check and c8 dependencies. Capture the live application image, add a scoped overlay, validate in the standard bounded isolated Compose stack, deploy the application only with rollback available. No NetSuite writes, database migrations, dependency changes or git commits.
acceptance: Actual IR15183 verifies against its original five-line request when the additional freight line is verified against its source PO.
Only PO item receipts can accept additional Other Charge purchase lines; require source line, item, quantity bounds, units, location, rate and amount agreement.
The original immutable request and inventory quantities remain unchanged; store accepted extra charge evidence on the posting step.
The source PO is read only for additional purchase charge lines; ordinary IF, TO IR and PO IR paths retain their request counts and strict matching.
A partial inventory receipt plus freight completes the posting job and returns its IR number, leaves the order partially received, and preserves the unreceived balance.
A later receipt consumes only the remaining quantity and preserves the first receipt and its IR number.
Lost-response recovery verifies the same existing IR with no second transform; repeated and concurrent processing cannot create duplicate local receipts.
Unverified extra inventory, wrong source or external identity, wrong quantity, invalid charges, duplicate line identities and unreadable source evidence fail closed.
The deployed application returns IR15183 in the completed POB04042 job and receipt history; production health passes and every task-created test resource is removed.

failureModel.inventoryOverreceipt: Strict existing inventory checks retained; unit attacks and partial/follow-up integration tests.
failureModel.unverifiedFinancialLine: Source-backed charge proof, amount/rate tests, property tests and manual mutations.
failureModel.wrongRecord: Existing external ID, source PO and transaction type validation retained and exercised.
failureModel.partialMarkedComplete: Real repository/finalizer tests with nonzero balances and a later receipt.
failureModel.duplicateAfterRecovery: Original posting state machine and lease retained; recovery and concurrency regression tests.
failureModel.performanceRegression: No additional source read without candidate charge lines; request-count assertions.
failureModel.deploymentRegression: Capture current image; compare affected files, scoped overlay, full selected posting/receiving suite, image hash verification, healthy app-only cutover and rollback.
